Cell Biology Notes

- Cell: the smallest unit of life
- Nucleus: control center of the cell, holds DNA
- Cell membrane: thin barrier that controls what enters and leaves the cell
- Cytoplasm: jelly-like fluid that fills the cell
- Mitochondria: organelles that release energy from food
- Ribosomes: tiny structures that build proteins
- Chloroplasts: found only in plant cells, carry out photosynthesis
- Cell wall: stiff outer layer in plant cells, gives support
- Plant cells have a cell wall and chloroplasts, animal cells do not.
- Vacuole: storage sac for water and nutrients, very large in plant cells
